+Development environment: **Google Cloud Workstations**, using its browser editor
+and Bash terminal.
+
+This repository is the challenge starter: it contains the specification, review
+policy, JSON schema and 20 sample messages. Application code, dependencies, tests
+and generated deliverables have not been implemented yet. Read
+[CHALLENGE.md](CHALLENGE.md) for the full task and submission requirements.
+
+## Workstation setup
+
+The current workstation provides Ubuntu 24.04 (x86_64), Python 3.12, Node.js 24,
+Git, `uv` and the Google Cloud CLI (`gcloud`). Python 3.12 is the baseline for
+future Python development; Node.js and `gcloud` are not required to inspect the
+starter data. No Databricks cluster, notebook, DBFS mount or Databricks token is
+required.
+
+In the workstation terminal, open the existing checkout:
+
+```bash
+cd /home/user/ai-full-stack-it-access-requests
+git pull --ff-only
+python3 --version
+python3 -m venv .venv
+source .venv/bin/activate
+```
+
+If using a different workstation, clone the repository into your home directory
+first:
+
+```bash
+cd "$HOME"
+git clone https://github.com/Umerfed/ai-full-stack-it-access-requests.git
+cd ai-full-stack-it-access-requests
+```
+
+There are no application dependencies to install yet. When the application is
+implemented, commit its dependency manifest and lockfile and document the exact
+installation, intake, retry, queue-inspection, test and accuracy-check commands.
+
+## Model credentials
+
+The challenge supplies the model credential through `API_KEY`. Keep an existing
+injected value, or enter one for the current terminal without saving it in shell
+history:
+
+```bash
+read -rsp 'Model API key: ' API_KEY
+echo
+export API_KEY
+```
+
+[.env.example](.env.example) documents this variable. An optional local `.env`
+file is ignored by Git; the starter does not automatically load it. No model
